a02: Four agents, each with its own authority. The Letter Reader, on Nemotron 3 Ultra, turns the letter into quoted claims. The Registry Scout runs a floor of Zetaris checks; Nemotron Lightning adds what it misses. Before a link counts, the Examiner re-runs its Zetaris query and checks the rows. Code decides the verdict.
a06: Three processes. A CACI request reuses the phone from the impersonation we confirmed, and another reuses its account. The World Model remembers both; both are held.
